messages:
alex: Twilight shift — quick handoff snapshot (what I did / blockers / next)

alex: Incidents: regen-surge-eu-west — observed throughput drop and autoscaler flapping around 19:10-19:25 UTC. Mitigation applied: pinned pool to reserved-dedicated-3, scaled replicas to 8, enabled fallback routing to sgd-quantized. PD alert acknowledged.

alex: Logs + quick command I ran:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep regen
# regen-serve-0   1/1 Running   0     3m
# regen-serve-1   1/1 Running   0     2m
```

sam: Confirming — KVProxy was evicting frequently which increased cold-starts. I have a revert PR (#4127) that undoes the recent pool churn; left notes in the PR about the cache pressure window (19:12-19:18 UTC).

lina: Runbook: executed step 1/2 (scale, pin), step 3 queued (add circuit-breaker). Filing INF-2319 for follow-up on circuit-breaker + alert tuning.

alex: Blockers: need a quick review on the revert PR and a perf sanity check after the scale. Night actions: monitor autoscaler for 2h, keep canary disabled until stable, escalate to infra if nodes OOM or GPU memory climbs >85%. @sam can you take the PR?

sam: Will pick up PR now and run the perf job. If perf passes, schedule a small canary tomorrow 05:00 UTC. Posted metrics snapshot to eng-sre channel: https://grafana.redwood/local/regen?from=now-1h

PagerBot: PagerDuty INC-8343 acknowledged by alex — status: acknowledged, priority: P2.

tina: Quick blocker: I'm waiting on review for perf-test PR #4135 (integration test harness). Tests are green locally but need another engineer to approve.

lina: I'll do a quick review now, ETA ~20m. If green, please leave the tag for night-run.

alex: FYI I patched the regen routing policy to prefer fallback variants when median latency >150ms; this should reduce tail SLO violations. Config diff: `/ops/regen-routing` (small delta, safe rollback).

sam: noted. I'll watch the dashboard and set a temporary alert at 5% error rate and 200ms p95. :eyes:

alex: Handoff complete. I'm reachable on pager + slack for 30m, then oncall hands off to @sam. Leaving this thread open for async Qs.

sam: Copy — taking the watch. Will post an update if anything changes.

lina: Added INF-2319 and linked PRs. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
